blocks.text: The module documentation explains that profile.py defines the sandbox and this file starts it through a precise argv list. It also documents absolute PATH lookup, process-group behavior, and signal exit-code ambiguity.

purpose: This security-sensitive adapter turns a validated sandbox profile into the exact argument vector consumed by the shell tool. It avoids relative PATH lookups, selects an in-sandbox shell and optional bridge Python, and translates bubblewrap signal-style exit codes.
summary: Finds sandbox executables and builds the bubblewrap argv used to run a command inside the project profile.
